tweets.text: .@renato_mariotti & I agree: pass CLARITY. Not b/c it's a "gimme" for industry - news flash: it's not (😬). But b/c its better for consumers, for the economy. The crypto genie is out of the bottle; we can't put it back. We need serious laws & guardrails for the future of finance https://t.co/iI8K0cfNJw
tweets.summary: Rettig and Mariotti urge passing the CLARITY Act, arguing it provides needed consumer guardrails for crypto markets.

tweets.text: RT @Scaramucci: Here's what drives me crazy about Washington. Everybody demands compromise. Then when compromise actually happens, everybody pretends it doesn't count. Is CLARITY perfect? No. Could the ethics language do more? Yes. Is it ten times better than the Wild West status quo? Obviously. Democrats improved this bill in meaningful ways. Republicans moved. The President moved. The crypto industry moved. Bank the win.
tweets.summary: Scaramucci defends the bipartisan CLARITY Act compromise as far better than the current unregulated crypto status quo.

tweets.text: North Korea's Lazarus Group and other bad actors thrive on gaps in our financial rules. The Clarity Act gives Treasury new sanctions authority and a safe harbor for companies to freeze suspicious transactions before the money moves.
tweets.summary: Lummis says the Clarity Act grants Treasury new sanctions authority and a safe harbor to freeze suspicious crypto transactions.

tweets.text: RT @laurashin: If Clarity doesn't pass, I'm going to be very upset. And it's not because of crypto necessarily It's because the geopolitcal balance is precarious, and finance and tech are some of the most important industries that determine the global powers So if the US is not the leader, then who? There are no good options, which means if the US is not the leader, then things get bad I don't want to live in that world So Congresspeople, get your heads out of your asses and think about the world order and think about how important it is that the world leader big a capitalist democracy and not any of the other systems Please
tweets.summary: Commentary urging Congress to pass the crypto market-structure Clarity Act to preserve US leadership in finance and tech.

tweets.text: 🎲 @ColeGotTweets says trading the VIX means trading VIX options, a complicated product for most retail investors. Polymarket wraps volatility into a simple prediction market instead, he says. @bitsandbips https://t.co/Ws5XugzTUK
tweets.summary: Polymarket offers a prediction market on market volatility (VIX) as a simpler retail alternative to VIX options.
